name: 8D Corrective Action
description: 8D corrective-action child process spawned by Supplier Quality Deviation for CRITICAL severity; Procurement completes it. Escalation follows D-ESC: timer -> higher role -> fail closed (v1.1, ISS-1002 / Q-984; BA ruling GH #2281). The long-running corrective-action task carries a non-cancelling reminder (reminder_timer_duration P14D, reminder_role role-procurement-manager; REQ-494 / GH #2553, replaces the E6 waiver of v1.1): the reminder is audit-only (task.remind) and the task stays open, so no escalation timer can cancel it and close the parent deviation without corrective action.

attributes.description: Long-running remediation work: the 8D corrective action is open-ended, so it carries a reminder instead of an escalation timer (an escalation timer would cancel the task and close the deviation with no corrective action). It stays open until the procurement manager completes it.
